## Find creators with Roster

**Before you run**
1. Get your own data key at https://api.ugcroster.com/keys.
2. In the HTTP Request node, select Header Auth. Set name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_ROSTER_DATA_KEY` in the credential store.
3. Review the niche (`q`), creator country, page and result limit.

**One manual run = one search page / 10 credits.** Up to 20 results; no automatic pagination or retries. Check https://api.ugcroster.com/pricing for current access requirements. No credentials or creator records are included.

Returned profiles are stored directory data. Creator country is not audience geography. This workflow does not contact anyone.
